title: From the Table Now Retiring
description: From the Table Now Retiring in Tonic Solfa to GALILEE (JUDE), doh is Ab: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 3 verses and a piano.
about: These words were printed without an author's name in Hymns for Christian Devotion, compiled by John G. Adams and Edwin H. Chapin (Boston, 1846), as hymn 695 of its twenty-second edition (1853), “The Same”.

The book printed the words without tunes, marked Eights and Sevens (8.7.8.7), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to GALILEE (JUDE); any other Eights and Sevens tune fits them as well.
underlay: From the ta-ble now re-tir-ing, Which for us the Lord hath spread, May our souls, re-fresh-ment find-ing, Grow in all things like our Head.

lines: Which for us the Lord hath spread,
Grow in all things like our Head.
May our lives his image bear;
Him our Lord and Master calling,
Love to God and man displaying,
Peace from God, through endless day!

licence: Public domain: anonymous words in print by 1853.
credits: Words anonymous, public domain, as printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion (1853); set to GALILEE (JUDE) by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
